title: Norwegian Rocket Stir Fry
description: A quick and tangy Norwegian-inspired stir fry with a velvety twist.

ingredients.name: Velvety Sauce
ingredients.notes: See below for velvety sauce recipe

instructions: Heat stir fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add fry garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add rocket leaves and cook until wilted.
In a small bowl, whisk together velvety sauce ingredients.
Pour velvety sauce over rocket mixture and stir to combine.
Add Norwegian fjord salmon and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until heated through.
